description_en: Deletes resource instances from an application group
description_zh: 调用DeleteMonitorGroupInstances接口删除应用分组内的资源实例
name: DeleteMonitorGroupInstances

parameters.help_en: The ID of the application group
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the instances to be deleted. Separate multiple instance IDs with commas (,). You can delete up to 20 instances at a time
parameters.help_zh: 需要删除的实例，多个实例之间用英文逗号分隔开。一次最多能够删除20个
parameters.name: instance_id_list

parameters.help_en:
The abbreviation of the cloud service name.

For more information about how to obtain the abbreviation of a cloud service name, see the `metricCategory` field in the `Labels` response parameter of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/114916.html operation
parameters.help_zh:
云产品名称缩写。

关于如何获取云产品名称缩写，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/114916.html接口的返回参数0中的1
parameters.name: category

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform only a dry run on the request. Valid values:
true: performs a dry run. The system checks the required parameters, request format, and service limits, but does not delete the instances. If the request fails the check, an error is returned. If the request passes the check, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
false (default): performs a normal request. If the request passes the check, the instances are deleted
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会删除VPN连接。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接删除VPN连接
parameters.name: dry_run

Code.description_en:
The status code.

A value of 200 indicates success

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the operation is successful. Valid values:

true: The operation is successful.
false: The operation fails
Success.description_zh:
操作是否成功。取值：

true：表示成功。
false：表示失败
